描述_EN: fragmentary polychrome tapestry square. the hearts, in ecru, are inserted into a first circle, alternately green, blue and black, then into a second, larger circle, in red. a wider band of medallions frames the whole. In the center of the latter medallion is a rectangle decorated with an ecru-colored motif. in the medallions, on a red background, are four hearts whose tips meet. In the center of the piece is a larger medallion of the same octagonal shape, featuring a circular medallion surrounded by blue dots, on an ecru background. one can make out the edges of the piece, made up of a series of black triangular shapes.
描述_ZN: fragmentary polychrome tapestry square. 心的颜色为灰褐色，被插入第一个圆圈，交替为绿色、蓝色和黑色，然后插入第二个更大的圆圈，为红色。 一个更宽的奖章带框住了整体。 在后者的奖章中央是一个长方形，上面装饰着一个青灰色的图案。 在奖章中，四颗心的尖端相互交错，镶嵌在红色背景上。 在钱币的中央是一个更大的八角形的纪念章，其中在赤褐色的背景上画了一个由蓝色圆点包围的圆形奖章。 作品的边框是由一系列的黑色三角形组成的。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
